answer_1.quote: Text simplification involves the rewriting of a text to make it easier to read and understand by a wider audience, while still expressing the same core meaning.
answer_1.outputs: Real‑valued simplicity scores for each sentence (higher = simpler)

answer_2.quote: We compare SLE with four reference‑based and two reference‑less metrics previously used to assess the output of simplification models... Correlations with human ratings of simplicity are shown in Table. The best metric on Human‑Likert is LENS, closely followed by ∆SLE.

answer_4.quote: We evaluate SLE both in terms of its ability to perform the regression task and how well it correlates with human judgements of simplicity... Simplicity‑DA contains 600 system outputs, each with 15 ratings... Human‑Likert contains 100 human‑written sentence simplifications, each with ~60 simplicity ratings.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rated each simplification on simplicity (and also fluency and meaning preservation) using Likert‑scale questions.
